bill.title: A bill to prohibit the award of Federal education funds to educational institutions and agencies that do not allow for religious exemptions to vaccination requirements, and for other purposes.
bill.latestActionText: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.

classification.plainSummary: This bill would prohibit the federal government from awarding education funds to schools, colleges, and educational agencies that do not allow religious exemptions to their vaccination requirements. Educational institutions that wish to continue receiving federal funding would need to permit students and staff to claim religious exemptions from any vaccine mandates they impose.

industries.rationale: The bill directly regulates eligibility for federal education funding based on vaccination exemption policies at schools and universities.
Changes to vaccination requirement policies at educational institutions could affect demand for vaccines administered to students and staff.

method.formula: score = Σ_industries ( donorShare(industry) × billWeight(industry) ), where billWeight = classifierConfidence / Σ classifierConfidence. Range 0–1, read as a weighted share of disclosed itemized money.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
